ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels occupy approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in localized linear/circular anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white mottling is localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right). High-intensity white points and lines are scattered across the interior dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees; bounding box depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration. The left lobe exhibits a major macroscopic indentation (notch) roughly midway between the median notch and the tip. The right lobe shows a more continuous but distinctly jagged pixel-amplitude variation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges leading to sharp, upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white pixels (barnacle scars) are visible, particularly on the inner-left lobe and near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation, most prominent on the right lobe with multiple diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic indentation/missing segment on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive scarring and rake marks across the entire visible surface.
